# Template — Advance-Purchase Group Contract (interest-free finance substance)

> ⚠️ **Template only — professional review required.** Implements the
> platform's universal finance best practice in plain, non-religious
> language: an advance on defined goods with a transparent margin, no
> interest, no compounding penalties, full written terms. AgriSphere is the
> **documentation layer only**: it never holds money, never transfers funds,
> and is not a party to this contract. Money moves directly between the
> parties named below (or via licensed payment providers of their choice).
> Review by a lawyer/adviser before use; adapt to applicable law
> (including any credit-regulation law that may apply to advances).
> Fill every `[bracket]`.

**Title:** `[e.g. Advance purchase — 2026/27 sorghum, Tswapong group]`
**Date:** `[date]`

## Parties
1. **Advancing party (Buyer/Funder):** `[name, registration no., address, contact]`
2. **Producing party (Farmer/Group):** `[name(s), address, contact]` (schedule for groups)
3. **Documentation layer:** AgriSphere platform — records and stores this
   contract and the delivery/settlement evidence at the parties' request.
   AgriSphere is **not a party** to the sale or the advance.

## 1. The defined goods (the only basis of this contract)
- Product & grade: `[e.g. white sorghum, grade B+]`
- Quantity: `[e.g. 20 tonnes ± 10%]`
- Delivery window & point: `[e.g. May–June 2027; BAMB depot `[name]` / agreed scale]`
- Quality/specs reference: `[e.g. moisture ≤ 12%, weevil-free, per annex]`

## 2. The advance (interest-free by design)
1. Advance amount: `[P·]`, being `[·]%` of the estimated contract value
   (`[P·]` at the formula below on the estimated quantity).
2. Purpose of the advance (declared): `[e.g. certified seed + fertiliser +
   labour for the contracted area]`.
3. **No interest** accrues on the advance. The only charge is the agreed
   margin in the price formula (§3), which is disclosed in writing.
4. Disbursement & repayment mechanics: `[e.g. paid by direct transfer to
   the producer's bank/mobile-money account within 7 days of signature;
   recovered only by deduction against deliveries under this contract]`.
   AgriSphere never receives or holds the funds.

## 3. Price formula (transparent & written)
1. Formula: `[e.g. BAMB depot price in delivery week minus P·/t handling —
   or fixed P·/t — plus P·/t quality bonus at grade]`.
2. The margin, if any, is the Buyer/Funder's disclosed reward and is part
   of the formula — not an interest charge.
3. **Only deductions written here are allowed.** No other deductions, fees
   or penalties apply.

## 4. If delivery falls short (fair, non-exploitative triggers)
1. **Weather/verified crop failure:** documented via `[e.g. AgriSphere
   evidence records: photos, geo-holding, extension report]` →
   `[agreed relief, e.g. pro-rata repayment schedule over next season with
   no extra charge, or partial waiver]`.
2. **Shortfall due to the producer's default:** repayment of the undelivered
   portion of the advance `[in cash by date · / against next season's crop]`
   — **no compounding or punitive charges**.
3. **Buyer/Funder default (fails to pay balance on time):** written late
   notice; `[remedy, e.g. interest-free extension of 30 days, then the
   producer may sell the remaining crop elsewhere without penalty]`.
4. Disputes: `[e.g. joint grading with retained samples; escalation to the
   parties' chosen mediator before any legal step]`.

## 5. Documentation & evidence (why the platform is involved)
1. This contract, delivery records (quantity, date, quality, batch codes),
   settlement statements and any dispute records are stored on AgriSphere
   and are exportable by either party at any time.
2. The parties may choose to record the producing unit's geo-holding
   (consent-first) and delivery photos to evidence the chain — useful where
   the goods later enter regulated/export markets.

## 6. Independent advice & law
1. Each party confirms it has had the opportunity to take independent
   advice on this contract.
2. Governing law: `[Botswana / ·]`, courts of `[·]`. [Adapt after review.]
3. This contract does not create a partnership, agency or employment
   relationship between the parties, and nothing here authorises either
   party to hold itself out as the other's agent.

## Signatures
**Advancing party:** name/role/signature/date
**Producing party:** name(s)/signature(s)/date
**AgriSphere (documentation layer):** witness signature noting the records
are stored at the parties' request and AgriSphere is not a party to the
sale or the advance.

**Annexes:** quality spec sheet · group member schedule (if group) ·
evidence template (photos/geo/extension report).
